name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman
meaning: I bow to Hanuman, the reliever of difficulties. Grant me strength, wisdom and intellect, and remove my troubles.
note: The client list gives AUM Sri Hanumate Namaha (above) followed by a protection formula; that further line should be checked against a reliable source before it is recited as a fixed Sanskrit text.
supplied:
Aum Sri Hanumate Namaha
Sankat Mochan Bhoot Pisach Vinnashan
Raksha kuru kuru swaha.
